messages.content: I'd like to change my food order to a Caesar salad without anchovies, and for the drink, can you update my order 123 to a large hot coffee with regular sweetness and almond milk, please?

function.name: ChaFod
function.description: Changes the food item based on the customer's request, allowing for modifications to the ingredients or preparation method. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

foodItem.description: The name of the food item to be modified as requested by the customer.

newIngredients.description: A comma-separated list of new ingredients to include in the food item, if any.

removeIngredients.description: A comma-separated list of ingredients to remove from the food item, if any.

specialInstructions.description: Special preparation instructions provided by the customer, such as 'extra spicy' or 'no salt'.

function.name: ChaDri_change_drink
function.description: Modifies the existing drink order to accommodate the customer's new request, ensuring the drink is updated according to the specified preferences. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

drink_id.description: The unique identifier of the drink to be changed.

new_preferences.description: The updated preferences for the drink order.

size.description: The size of the drink the customer prefers.

temperature.description: The temperature at which the drink should be served.

sweetness_level.description: The sweetness level the customer requests for the drink.

milk_type.description: The type of milk to be used in the drink, if applicable.

special_instructions.description: Any additional instructions provided by the customer for the drink preparation.

message.content: Sure! To make sure I’m updating the right items, could you let me know the exact name of your current food order so I can switch it to a Caesar salad without anchovies? Once I have that, I’ll also adjust drink 123 to a large hot coffee with regular sweetness and almond milk.
message.reasoning:
The user wants two changes:

1) Food modification: Change their current food order (which we don't know but presumably they had something else). They want it to become a Caesar salad without anchovies.

2) Drink modification: Update drink id 123 to a large hot coffee with regular sweetness and almond milk.

We need to call both functions accordingly.

First function: ChaFod - modify food item. We have no specific food item name; maybe it's just "Caesar salad". But the function requires specifying the original food item name. Since not given, perhaps we assume the current food item is whatever was ordered earlier. In absence of details, we might use placeholder "current_food_item".

But better approach: ask clarifying question about what food item currently exists. However guidelines say we cannot ask clarifying questions unless necessary. Here we do need clarification because we don't know the original food item's name. So we could respond asking them to specify the current food item they'd like to replace. That would be appropriate.

Thus answer: Ask for clarification regarding the current food item.
